name: merge_down
declaration: unsafe fn merge_down < F : FnMut (& T , & T) -> bool > (& mut self , left_end : * const T , right_end : * const T , mut out : * mut T , is_less : & mut F ,)
documentation:
# Safety
 The caller MUST guarantee that `self` is initialized in a way where `left_end <- dst` is
 the shorter sub-slice and so that `out` can be written to at least the shorter sub-slice
 length times. In addition `left_end <- dst` and `right_end <- end` MUST be valid to be
 read. This function MUST only be called once.
rules: The caller must ensure that `self` is initialized so that `left_end <- dst` is the shorter sub-slice.
The caller must ensure that `out` can be written to at least as many times as the length of the shorter sub-slice, `left_end <- dst`.
The caller must ensure that `left_end <- dst` is valid to be read.
The caller must ensure that `right_end <- end` is valid to be read.
